ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop.Journalism Master's students should register for lab section AB3 (CRN 63003). Non-Journalism majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program should visit https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/1773821 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Agricultural Communications major(s).
